Working while studying

Students on an approved course may work part-time. Check the rules below before you accept a job, and keep your registration card. Rules differ for term time, and for holiday periods.

Term time

During term time you may work up to a weekly limit.
Your employer may ask to see your card.

  • Keep payslips for every job.
  • Tell the college if your hours change.
    • Changes must be reported within a month.

Holiday periods

Different limits apply in holiday periods, listed in the table.

Course typeHours per weekPeriod
Example Level 8 course12Term time
Example Level 9 course34Holidays

Frequently asked questions

Can I be self-employed?

No. Self-employment is not allowed on a student permission.

Can I volunteer?

Yes, unpaid volunteering is allowed.

More questions

What happens if I break the rules?

Your permission may be withdrawn, so ask the college first if you are unsure.
